newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ICI says not rushing petrochem plant.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ICI says not rushing petrochem plant.

text.p: Chemicals and plastics group ICI Australia Ltd on Friday confirmed a newspaper report that it was considering a petrochemicals plant in Western Australia.

"The West Australian government has encouraged us to have a look at it but there's a lot of water to run under the bridge," managing director Warren Haynes told a news conference after the company's annual meeting.
ICI would only be a minor participant in the possible venture, which would cost between A$2.0 billion and A$2.4 billion to build, Haynes said.
